$comment: Phase 4 sound effects (ByteDance Seed Audio on OpenRouter). Run: OPEN_ROUTER_KEY=... pnpm --filter @civolution/assets sounds -- --manifest manifests/phase4-sounds.json. Prompts get a 'The sound of' prefix automatically.

items.prompt: two distant horns answering each other across a wide valley, followed by a soft ceremonial drum roll, without voices, about three seconds
a herald's short brass fanfare and footsteps on a stone floor as heavy palace doors swing open, without voices, about two seconds
a quill scratching across parchment, then a wax seal pressed down with a firm thud and a small bell chime, about two seconds
a heavy book closing on a wooden table and a chair pushed back across a stone floor, without voices, about one and a half seconds
a flag snapping in the wind on a tall pole, a rope pulley creaking and a short bright trumpet call, about two seconds
a soft click of a lock opening, papers being slipped quickly into a leather satchel and quiet footsteps hurrying away, about two seconds
a guard's whistle, running footsteps on cobblestones and an iron cell door slamming shut, without voices, about two seconds
a propeller aircraft droning overhead and several parachutes snapping open in the wind, fabric fluttering, about three seconds
a large transport aircraft's engines roaring up for takeoff on a runway and climbing away, about three seconds
oars splashing, wooden boat hulls grinding onto a pebble beach, waves breaking and a rough war horn blown, without words, about three seconds
